regions.label: main block floorplate (2-story slab, interior not visible)

evidence.visual_note: 1F-material-top: 细墙线勾出的南北向长方形板楼轮廓；1F ne/nw/sw/se 斜视：两个楼层带，立面呈不透明白色，室内不可见

evidence.visual_note: 1F-material-top: 板楼东北侧贴连的无特征屋面区；1F ne/se 斜视：东北角为三层楼带的塔楼翼

regions.label: recessed entrance alcove between main block and tower (SE side)

evidence.visual_note: 1F-material-se: 板楼与塔楼交接处内凹，内有深色雨棚下的地面入口；顶视中对应深灰方形(约[0.72,0.50,0.80,0.585])；凹入范围由布局推断

evidence.visual_note: 1F-material-nw/sw: 西面南段地面层深色内凹门洞，上方有浅色雨棚；顶视中被冲白，无法在顶视定位端点

regions.label: main block 2F floorplate (envelope only, interior not visible)

evidence.visual_note: 2F-material-top(本层取景)：板楼左缘约x=0.18、右缘约x=0.72，上下缘被画面裁切；2F ne/sw/se 斜视：二层楼带连续，立面不透明

regions.label: NE tower wing 2F floorplate (middle level of 3-story tower)

evidence.visual_note: 2F-material-ne/se: 塔楼中层楼带及白色雨棚开口；2F-material-top: 东侧淡色屋面区

properties.topology_warning: Anchor is free-grid evidence, not a visually confirmed doorway

regions.label: main-block roof deck (railed, canopy arrays on posts)

evidence.visual_note: 3F-material-top 及四张3F斜视：主块顶部为带连续金属栏杆的露台，棚架阵列之间见外露红色调地坪；上下缘在本帧被裁切

properties.topology_warning: Anchor is free-grid evidence, not a visually confirmed doorway

evidence.visual_note: 3F-material-nw/ne: 塔楼顶层内部可见——沿墙成排货架及小件物品、平整地坪，顶为白色实板；北/西面是开放还是装玻璃无法分辨

entities.label: ground-level entrance door (dark recess) with canopy above, west face near SW corner

evidence.visual_note: 1F-material-nw 与 sw: 深棕色内凹门洞，雨棚位于一层楼带高度；沿墙确切位置为两视角近似投影

entities.label: dark entrance canopy over recessed door in SE alcove

evidence.visual_note: 1F/2F/3F 三张顶视同位置均见深灰方形；1F/2F se 斜视：为凹入处地面门上方的深色雨棚

entities.label: tower mid-level exterior opening with white awning (door or window)

evidence.visual_note: 2F-material-ne 与 se: 塔楼中间层带见白色挑出雨棚及深色开口；该开口位于塔楼南面还是东面两视角存在歧义，仅给出角部包络

entities.label: elevated panel array on posts, north zone

evidence.visual_note: 3F-material-top: 北区网格状矩形阵列；3F ne/nw 斜视：面板由白色立柱架高于露台面；用途(光伏/遮阳)不可判定；本帧上缘略裁切

entities.label: elevated panel array on posts, middle zone

evidence.visual_note: 3F-material-top 中区网格阵列；3F 四张斜视均见中部柱撑面板组，板下见露台地面

entities.label: elevated panel array on posts, south zone

evidence.visual_note: 3F-material-top 南区网格阵列；3F sw/se 斜视见南部柱撑面板组；本帧下缘裁切
全部15张斜视：主块屋面四周连续金属栏杆，勾出露台边界

entities.label: wall shelving racks with small items in tower-top room

evidence.visual_note: 1F/2F/3F nw 斜视：塔楼顶层沿内壁成排货架，架上密集小件；具体贴附哪面墙为近似，端点未定位
